news.title: Iowa district to settle with recruiting firm after ex-superintendent’s ICE arrest
news.summary: The former Des Moines school leader overstayed his visa, according to ICE. In response, the district sued a firm it claimed should have prevented his hiring.

news.title: SpaceX can’t force retaliation claim into arbitration, 9th Circuit holds
news.summary: The Ending Forced Arbitration Act allows the former employees to pursue in court a claim they were fired for raising concerns about sexual harassment, which they alleged founder Elon Musk normalized through social media.

news.title: SEC aims to pare back executive comp disclosure rules
news.summary: Under a new proposal, public companies would get more flexibility to determine whether certain perks are “integrally and directly related” to an executive’s job.

news.title: Feds seek overhaul of permanent immigrant worker regulations
news.summary: The sweeping update aims to give U.S. workers “fair consideration and first access to job opportunities,” Secretary of Labor Keith Sonderling said on Monday.

news.title: Want to combat AI brainrot? PwC is piloting a way to do so.
news.summary: Several studies indicate that workers assigned to use AI recognize its negative cognitive effects.

news.title: Ex-Chanel worker alleging age bias claims she was told to ‘dress young’
news.summary: The plaintiff also alleged that she was pressured to exceed medical restrictions placed by her doctor following a stroke.

news.title: How to take the chaos — and cost — out of cross-border payroll
news.summary: The right payroll platform can meaningfully improve the process of paying a distributed, growing workforce.

news.title: CFO job descriptions are outdated, experts say
news.summary: With finance chiefs handling a wider range of duties, including tech rollouts, traditional job descriptions continue to fall short.

news.title: Job applicants say they are using AI to discover, investigate companies
news.summary: More than half of candidates said they declined to apply for a job after learning about a company through artificial intelligence, per a new study.

news.title: Annual 401(k) limit pushed to $25,500 for 2027, IRS announces
news.summary: The update comes days after the Trump administration advanced a final rule to expand access to alternative assets within workers’ defined-contribution plans.
